```{r}
library(pacman)

p_load(tidyverse, ggridges)

theme_set(theme_minimal())

```

```{r}
df_cond = read.csv('behaviour_bouts_raw_by_condition_vol2.csv') %>% 
  mutate(group = ifelse(mouse_id %in% c("372", "376", "423", "398", "400", "459"), 'NE', NA),
         group = ifelse(mouse_id %in% c("374", "429", "461", "463", "402"), 'WT', group),
         cond_group = paste0(condition, ', ', group)
         ) 
```


```{r}
behaviors_list = c('Social_interaction', 'Novel_interaction')

for (b in behaviors_list) {
  
plot = df_cond %>% 
  filter(behavior == b) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = duration_s, y = week)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = 3, 
                      rel_min_height = 0, 
                      quantile_lines = T, 
                      quantiles = 0.5,
                      alpha = 0.7,
                      bandwidth = 2
                      ) +
  facet_wrap(~cond_group, 
             #scales = 'free'
             )  +
  #scale_x_continuous(lim = c(20, 90)) +
  labs(title = b) # +
  #scale_y_discrete(breaks = function(y) y[seq(1, length(y), by = 2)]) + 
  #theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), 
  #      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20)
  #      )

print(plot)
}
```
